summary.zh-Hans: 海滨大道位于孟买南部，沿阿拉伯海岸弯曲延伸，设有供人散步和休息的海滨空间。
summary.en: Marine Drive curves along the Arabian Sea in South Mumbai, with a promenade where people walk and rest.

names.zh-Hans: 尼赫鲁科学中心科学园
names.en: Science Park at Nehru Science Centre

summary.zh-Hans: 尼赫鲁科学中心的科学园设有滑轮、跷跷板等互动展品，也有展示杠杆的装置。
summary.en: The Science Park at Nehru Science Centre has interactive exhibits including pulleys and seesaws, as well as a giant lever exhibit.

summary.zh-Hans: Vada pav 在柔软的小面包里夹入炸土豆团，搭配 chutney 调味酱，是孟买的街头食物。
summary.en: Vada pav is a Mumbai street food with a potato fritter inside a soft bread roll, accompanied by chutneys.

summary.zh-Hans: Pav bhaji 将加香料的蔬菜咖喱与涂黄油的烤面包搭配食用，在孟买可以见到。
summary.en: Pav bhaji pairs spiced vegetable curry with buttered toasted bread and is served in Mumbai.
